Class PoolChatServer

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.pool.PoolChatServer
All Implemented Interfaces:
PoolChat
public final class PoolChatServer extends Object implements PoolChat
The PoolChatServer class is the pool of ACP seats. The class implements PoolChat. It keeps one child for each user. It keeps at most three children. Stdout and stderr run on Lane.POOL_IO. prompt(String, String, String, boolean, String, PoolChat.Sink) blocks the caller until the turn finishes. A blank casserole.pool.host keeps the local child. The working directory is ~/.casserole/pool-cwd. Windows starts cmd.exe /c grok agent stdio. Any other operating system starts grok agent stdio. The child environment does not receive XAI_API_KEY. A set host dials ws://host:port/ws on grok agent serve. The JSON-RPC lines stay the same. The serve token is not logged. An idle child is destroyed after 15 minutes. One stdout line is capped at 1 MiB. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#PoolChatServer

  • Constructor Details

    • PoolChatServer

      public PoolChatServer(Lamina lamina, CasseroleProperties properties)
      The constructor stores the lane submitter and prepares an empty child map. The working directory is ~/.casserole/pool-cwd. The idle timer is a daemon named pool-idle. A shutdown hook named pool-chat-shutdown calls shutdown(). A null properties object, or a blank host, keeps the local grok agent stdio child.
      Parameters:
      lamina - The lamina submits stdout and stderr work. POOL_IO must already exist.
      properties - The properties carry casserole.pool.host, casserole.pool.port, and casserole.pool.secret.

    • prompt

      public void prompt(String user, String text, String boot, boolean think, String rules, PoolChat.Sink sink) throws Exception
      The prompt method runs one turn on the user's child and blocks until that turn finishes. A null sink returns at once. A null user is stored as an empty name. A null text and a null boot are stored as empty strings. A null rules string is stored as an empty string. If the server is shut down, the sink receives pool down. If the child cannot be created, the sink receives pool down. An interrupt restores the thread interrupt flag and is thrown again. A dead child is started again before the turn. The method then calls runPrompt(PoolChatServer.Child, String, String). An interrupt during that call cancels the session, drops the hold, restores the interrupt flag, and is thrown again. The prompt flags are cleared when the call leaves the gate. The idle timer is armed after the turn.
      Specified by:
      prompt in interface PoolChat
      Parameters:
      user - The user is the user name.
      text - The text is the working-set string for this turn.
      boot - The boot is the boot id. An empty boot does not keep a hold.
      think - The flag is true when thought chunks are forwarded.
      rules - The rules are sent on the next session/new. An empty string leaves _meta off.
      sink - The sink receives thought text, reply text, and the done call.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception when the wait is interrupted.

    • cancel

      public void cancel(String user)
      The cancel method asks the user's child to stop the current turn. A null user is treated as an empty name. A missing child returns. The cancel flag is set and waiting readers are woken. sendCancel(PoolChatServer.Child) writes session/cancel when a session is open.
      Specified by:
      cancel in interface PoolChat
      Parameters:
      user - The user is the user name.

    • shutdown

      public void shutdown()
      The shutdown method stops the pool. A second call returns at once. The idle timer is cancelled. Every child is destroyed and the map is cleared. Waiting cap checks are woken. When the caller is not the shutdown hook, the hook is removed. An illegal-state exception from that removal is ignored because the runtime may already be exiting.
      Specified by:
      shutdown in interface PoolChat

    • runPrompt

      private void runPrompt(PoolChatServer.Child child, String full, String boot) throws Exception
      The runPrompt method sends one working set to the child. A held session that canExtend(PoolChatServer.Child, String, String) accepts sends only the tail after the held text. Every other prompt drops the hold, opens a session, and sends the whole working set. PoolChat.TooLarge cancels the session and drops the hold. The sink done call is left to the forward path, which sets the skip flag. An interrupt cancels, drops the hold, and is thrown again. An I/O failure drops the hold and, unless done is skipped or cancel was asked, calls the sink with pool down. Any other exception uses pool payload.
      Parameters:
      child - The child is the live process for this user.
      full - The full text is the whole working-set string.
      boot - The boot is the boot id. An empty boot does not keep a hold.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception when the wait is interrupted.

    • prepareProcess

      private boolean prepareProcess(PoolChatServer.Child child, String full, String boot) throws Exception
      The prepareProcess method sends initialize once for this process. A child that is already initialized returns true. stopHere(PoolChatServer.Child, PoolChatServer.Outcome) cancels, drops the hold, and returns false. PoolChatServer.Outcome.DEAD calls retry(PoolChatServer.Child, String, String) and returns false. PoolChatServer.Outcome.FAIL drops the hold, finishes the failure, and returns false. Any other result marks the child initialized and returns true.
      Parameters:
      child - The child is the live process.
      full - The full text is the working set passed to a retry.
      boot - The boot is the boot id passed to a retry.
      Returns:
      The return value is false when this prompt is already finished.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception when the child call fails.

    • openSession

      private boolean openSession(PoolChatServer.Child child, String full, String boot) throws Exception
      The openSession method sends session/new with the child's rules. stopHere(PoolChatServer.Child, PoolChatServer.Outcome) cancels, drops the hold, and returns false. PoolChatServer.Outcome.DEAD calls retry(PoolChatServer.Child, String, String) and returns false. PoolChatServer.Outcome.FAIL drops the hold and finishes the failure. Any other result that is not PoolChatServer.Outcome.OK drops the hold and, when a sink is present, calls it with pool down. PoolChatServer.Outcome.OK returns true.
      Parameters:
      child - The child is the live process.
      full - The full text is the working set passed to a retry.
      boot - The boot is the boot id passed to a retry.
      Returns:
      The return value is false when this prompt is already finished.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception when the child call fails.

    • sendTurn

      private void sendTurn(PoolChatServer.Child child, String body, String full, String boot) throws Exception
      The sendTurn method sends session/prompt and finishes the sink. stopHere(PoolChatServer.Child, PoolChatServer.Outcome) cancels and drops the hold. PoolChatServer.Outcome.DEAD retries when nothing was forwarded and this is the first try. Otherwise it drops the hold and, when a sink is present, calls it with pool down. PoolChatServer.Outcome.FAIL drops the hold and finishes the failure. PoolChatServer.Outcome.OK calls the sink with an empty reason and the assembled answer, then align(PoolChatServer.Child, String, String, String) stores the hold.
      Parameters:
      child - The child is the live process.
      body - The body is the text sent on this prompt. It is the tail when the session extends.
      full - The full text is the whole working set stored on success.
      boot - The boot is the boot id stored on success.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception when the child call fails.

    • canExtend

      private boolean canExtend(PoolChatServer.Child child, String full, String boot)
      The canExtend method reports whether this prompt may send only the tail. The hold must be valid. The boot must be non-empty and equal the held boot. rulesHold(String, String) must match. The process must be initialized, alive, and still running. The session id must be set. The held text must be non-empty. The full text must start with that held text and be longer. A different rules string, including a change to empty, returns false, so the whole working set is sent once. The next success with the same rules may send the tail again. // @aa-sdd PK-1089 docs/specs/common/formal-plan.spec.md FINESSE:f-190
      Parameters:
      child - The child is the process that may already hold a session.
      full - The full text is the whole working set.
      boot - The boot is the boot id for this prompt.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when only the tail should be sent.

    • rulesHold

      static boolean rulesHold(String held, String next)
      The rulesHold method reports whether the held rules still match this prompt. A null held value returns false, because that hold does not remember rules. A null next value is compared as an empty string. An empty next matches an empty hold. A different string does not extend. // @aa-sdd PK-1089 docs/specs/common/formal-plan.spec.md FINESSE:f-190
      Parameters:
      held - The held text is the rules stored when this session opened, or null.
      next - The next text is the rules for this prompt. An empty string is the off value.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when the rules still match.

    • align

      private void align(PoolChatServer.Child child, String full, String boot, String answer)
      The align method stores the working set and the reply for a later tail send. An empty boot drops the hold and returns. A non-empty answer is stored after the working set as assistant, a newline, the answer, and two newlines. An empty answer stores the working set alone. The held rules become the current rules string, or empty when that string is null. The hold is then valid.
      Parameters:
      child - The child receives the hold fields.
      full - The full text is the working set that was sent.
      boot - The boot is the boot id this hold belongs to.
      answer - The answer is the assembled reply text.

    • dropHold

      private void dropHold(PoolChatServer.Child child)
      The dropHold method clears the held session. The next prompt opens a session. The process stays up. The hold flag, the held text, the held boot, the held rules, and the session id are cleared.
      Parameters:
      child - The child loses its hold.

    • retry

      private boolean retry(PoolChatServer.Child child, String text, String boot) throws Exception
      The retry method restarts the process once and sends the whole working set on a new session. If text was already forwarded, a retry already ran, cancel was asked, or done is skipped, the method cancels, drops the hold, and may call the sink with pool down. It then returns false. A spawn failure drops the hold, calls the sink with pool down, and returns false. Initialize and session/new follow the same stop, fail, and down branches and return false. The new prompt uses the whole text. A failed or dead turn drops the hold and finishes the sink. Success calls the sink with an empty reason and the answer, then stores the hold. Every path returns false.
      Parameters:
      child - The child is restarted.
      text - The text is the whole working set.
      boot - The boot is the boot id stored on success.
      Returns:
      The return value is false on every path.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception when a child call fails.

      The stopHere method reports whether the wait should end without a normal result. The outcome PoolChatServer.Outcome.STOP, a skipped done, a cancel request, or a shut server returns true.
      Parameters:
      child - The child carries the skip and cancel flags.
      outcome - The outcome is the wait result.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when the caller should stop this prompt.

    • finishFail

      private void finishFail(PoolChatServer.Child child) throws Exception
      The finishFail method delivers the stored failure to the sink. A null sink, a skipped done, or a cancel request returns without a call. An empty stored reason is sent as pool payload. A null stored message is sent as an empty string.
      Parameters:
      child - The child holds the failure reason and message.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception when the sink throws it.

    • waitFor

      private PoolChatServer.Outcome waitFor(PoolChatServer.Child child, int id) throws InterruptedException
      The waitFor method waits until the child's outcome id matches the request. Shutdown, cancel, a skipped done, or a dead child also ends the wait. Those three flags return PoolChatServer.Outcome.STOP. A dead child returns PoolChatServer.Outcome.DEAD. A matching id returns the stored outcome.
      Parameters:
      child - The child is the process being waited on.
      id - The id is the request id this wait expects.
      Returns:
      The return value is the outcome.
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - The method throws this exception when the wait is interrupted.

    • retire

      private static void retire(PoolChatServer.Child child, int id)
      The retire method keeps one finished request id. The caller already holds the child lock. An id below 1 returns. Any other id is stored. A later response for that id is ignored.
      Parameters:
      child - The child stores the id.
      id - The id is the request id that is no longer outstanding.

    • request

      private int request(PoolChatServer.Child child, String method, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode params) throws IOException
      The request method writes one JSON-RPC request and returns its id. The envelope uses jsonrpc 2.0, the next id, the method, and the params. The previous expected id is retired. The expected id and method are stored before the write. The stored outcome is cleared to PoolChatServer.Outcome.NONE.
      Parameters:
      child - The child receives the line.
      method - The method is the JSON-RPC method name.
      params - The params are the JSON-RPC parameters.
      Returns:
      The return value is the request id.
      Throws:
      IOException - The method throws this exception when the write fails.

    • sendCancel

      private void sendCancel(PoolChatServer.Child child)
      The sendCancel method writes session/cancel once. If a cancel was already sent, the session id is missing, the process is missing, or the process is not alive, the sent flag is set and the method returns. Otherwise the previous cancel id is retired, the new cancel id is stored, and the method writes a JSON-RPC request whose method is session/cancel and whose params carry the session id. A write failure is ignored.
      Parameters:
      child - The child receives the cancel line.

    • denyPermission

      private void denyPermission(PoolChatServer.Child child, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode node)
      The denyPermission method answers one permission request with a refusal. rejectOption(JsonNode) prefers reject_once, then reject_always. A found id is sent as outcome selected. No id is sent as outcome cancelled. The tool title, the command, and the input stay off this reply. A missing id is written as JSON null. A write failure calls fail(PoolChatServer.Child, String, String, String) with reason pool tool refused and place session/request_permission.
      Parameters:
      child - The child receives the reply.
      node - The node is the child's request.

    • rejectOption

      private static String rejectOption(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode node)
      The rejectOption method picks a refusal id from the permission options. A missing options array returns an empty string. The first option whose kind is reject_once is returned at once. If none exists, the first kind reject_always is returned. An option with an empty id is skipped.
      Parameters:
      node - The node is the child's permission request.
      Returns:
      The return value is the reject option id, or an empty string when the list has no reject kind.

    • writeLocked

      private void writeLocked(PoolChatServer.Child child, String json) throws IOException
      The writeLocked method writes one JSON line and flushes it. A null writer throws an I/O exception with the message spawn.
      Parameters:
      child - The child owns the writer.
      json - The json is one JSON object without a trailing newline.
      Throws:
      IOException - The method throws this exception when the writer is missing or the write fails.

    • initializeParams

      private com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode initializeParams()
      The initializeParams method builds the initialize parameters. protocolVersion is 1. clientCapabilities is an empty object.
      Returns:
      The return value is the parameters object.

    • sessionNewParams

      private com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode sessionNewParams(String rules)
      The sessionNewParams method builds session/new parameters for this server. The working directory is the absolute pool directory. The rules string is passed through.
      Parameters:
      rules - The rules are placed in _meta.rules when the trimmed text is non-empty.
      Returns:
      The return value is the parameters object from porchSessionParams(ObjectMapper, String, String).

    • porchSessionParams

      static com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode porchSessionParams(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper mapper, String cwd, String rules)
      The porchSessionParams method builds session/new parameters. A null directory is stored as an empty cwd. mcpServers is an empty array. A non-blank rules string is stored as _meta.rules. A null or blank string leaves _meta off. yoloMode, autoMode, and systemPromptOverride are not set.
      Parameters:
      mapper - The mapper creates the JSON objects.
      cwd - The cwd is the absolute pool directory.
      rules - The rules are the text for _meta.rules, or empty.
      Returns:
      The return value is the parameters object.

    • promptParams

      private com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode promptParams(PoolChatServer.Child child, String text)
      The promptParams method builds session/prompt parameters. The prompt is one block whose type is text. A null session id is sent as an empty string.
      Parameters:
      child - The child supplies the session id.
      text - The text is the prompt body.
      Returns:
      The return value is the parameters object.

    • ensure

      private PoolChatServer.Child ensure(String user) throws IOException, InterruptedException
      The ensure method returns a live child for the user, creating one when needed. An existing live process is returned. A dead entry is destroyed and removed. When three children already exist, the method waits. The pool directory is created when it is missing. A failed create throws an I/O exception with the message spawn. The new child starts at generation 1, and its pumps are submitted. After shutdown the method throws spawn.
      Parameters:
      user - The user is the map key.
      Returns:
      The return value is the live child.
      Throws:
      IOException - The method throws this exception when the directory or the process cannot be started.
      InterruptedException - The method throws this exception when the cap wait is interrupted.

    • respawn

      private void respawn(PoolChatServer.Child child) throws IOException
      The respawn method replaces the child's process. The old process is destroyed. The pool directory is created when it is missing. The generation increases by one. The child is marked alive and not initialized. The hold is dropped. The stderr count and the cancel-sent flag are cleared. New pumps are submitted.
      Parameters:
      child - The child receives the new process.
      Throws:
      IOException - The method throws this exception when the directory or the process cannot be started.

    • openLink

      private PoolLink openLink() throws IOException
      The openLink method opens the seat configured for this server. A remote address dials the WebSocket. Any other address starts grok agent stdio. A remote dial does not create the pool directory. The directory is still created by the caller before this method.
      Returns:
      The return value is the open link.
      Throws:
      IOException - The method throws this exception when the process or the socket cannot start.

    • startProcess

      private Process startProcess() throws IOException
      The startProcess method starts grok agent stdio. Windows uses cmd.exe /c grok agent stdio. Any other operating system uses grok agent stdio. The working directory is the pool directory. Standard input, output, and error are pipes. XAI_API_KEY is removed from the child environment without regard to case.
      Returns:
      The return value is the started process.
      Throws:
      IOException - The method throws this exception when the process cannot start.

    • startPumps

      private void startPumps(PoolChatServer.Child child)
      The startPumps method submits the stdout and stderr readers. Both tasks use Lane.POOL_IO. The task names are pool-stdout and pool-stderr. Each task keeps the child's current generation.
      Parameters:
      child - The child supplies the process and the generation.

    • destroyProcess

      private void destroyProcess(PoolChatServer.Child child)
      The destroyProcess method force-stops the child's process. A null process returns. The method waits up to 2 seconds. An interrupt restores the thread interrupt flag.
      Parameters:
      child - The child owns the process.

    • bumpIdle

      private void bumpIdle(PoolChatServer.Child child)
      The bumpIdle method advances the idle token so an older timer does not reap this child.
      Parameters:
      child - The child owns the idle token.

    • armIdle

      private void armIdle(PoolChatServer.Child child)
      The armIdle method schedules a reap 15 minutes out. A shut server returns. The idle token advances, and the timer stores that new token.
      Parameters:
      child - The child is the process the timer may destroy.

    • dispatch

      private void dispatch(PoolChatServer.Child child, int generation, String line)
      The dispatch method routes one stdout line. A generation mismatch or a null line returns. A blank line returns. Text that is not JSON, or JSON that is not an object, fails with reason pool parse and place stdout. An object with an id and a result or an error goes to onResponse(PoolChatServer.Child, JsonNode). An object with a method goes to onMethod(PoolChatServer.Child, JsonNode).
      Parameters:
      child - The child receives the parsed frame.
      generation - The generation is the process generation that read the line.
      line - The line is one stdout record.

    • onResponse

      private void onResponse(PoolChatServer.Child child, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode node)
      The onResponse method records one JSON-RPC response. A missing id is read as -1. The cancel id is ignored. A retired id is ignored. An id other than the expected id fails with reason pool payload and detail id. A non-null error goes to onErrorLocked(PoolChatServer.Child, JsonNode). A session/new result with an empty session id fails with place session/new and detail sessionId. Any other accepted result stores PoolChatServer.Outcome.OK and wakes the waiter.
      Parameters:
      child - The child stores the outcome.
      node - The node is the response object.

    • onErrorLocked

      private void onErrorLocked(PoolChatServer.Child child, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode error)
      The onErrorLocked method records one JSON-RPC error. The caller already holds the child lock. A message that contains login or auth words uses reason pool auth and sets the auth-failed flag. Any other error uses pool payload. A non-auth error with a numeric code puts code and that number in the detail, then the redacted message when it is non-empty.
      Parameters:
      child - The child stores the failure.
      error - The error is the JSON-RPC error object.

    • onMethod

      private void onMethod(PoolChatServer.Child child, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode node)
      The onMethod method handles one child-initiated message. A message with an id whose method name contains permission is refused by denyPermission(PoolChatServer.Child, JsonNode). Any other request fails with pool payload and then sendCancel(PoolChatServer.Child) runs. The match ignores case. A notice that is not session/update only increments the note count. An update whose session id is non-empty and differs from the child session id only increments the note count. tool_call and tool_call_update do the same. agent_message_chunk and agent_thought_chunk go to forward(PoolChatServer.Child, boolean, String). Any other update only increments the note count.
      Parameters:
      child - The child receives the message.
      node - The node is the JSON object.

    • forward

      private void forward(PoolChatServer.Child child, boolean thought, String chunk)
      The forward method sends one chunk to the sink. A null or empty chunk returns. A thought chunk returns when think is off. A closed prompt or a null sink returns. Reply text is appended to the assembled answer. Thought text is not appended. The forwarded flag is set. Thought text calls PoolChat.Sink.thought(String). Reply text calls PoolChat.Sink.message(String). PoolChat.TooLarge cancels the session, sets the skip flag, and does not call done. An I/O exception fails with pool down. Any other exception fails with pool payload.
      Parameters:
      child - The child owns the sink and the assembled answer.
      thought - The flag is true for agent_thought_chunk.
      chunk - The chunk is the text piece.

    • note

      private void note(PoolChatServer.Child child)
      The note method counts one ignored child message.
      Parameters:
      child - The child owns the note count.

    • fail

      private void fail(PoolChatServer.Child child, String reason, String place, String detail)
      The fail method stores a failure while holding the child lock.
      Parameters:
      child - The child stores the failure.
      reason - The reason is the done reason.
      place - The place is the step name placed in the message.
      detail - The detail is the extra text placed in the message.

    • failLocked

      private void failLocked(PoolChatServer.Child child, String reason, String place, String detail)
      The failLocked method stores a failure. The caller already holds the child lock. If this expected id is already PoolChatServer.Outcome.FAIL, the method returns. Otherwise it stores the reason and the clipped message, closes the prompt, sets PoolChatServer.Outcome.FAIL, and wakes the waiter.
      Parameters:
      child - The child stores the failure.
      reason - The reason is the done reason.
      place - The place is the step name placed in the message.
      detail - The detail is the extra text placed in the message.

    • markDead

      private void markDead(PoolChatServer.Child child, int generation)
      The markDead method marks one generation dead and wakes waiters. The exit code is read when the process is already gone. A process that is still alive, or a missing process, keeps code -1. A generation mismatch returns without changing the child. A matching generation clears alive, stores PoolChatServer.Outcome.DEAD, and wakes both the child wait and the cap wait.
      Parameters:
      child - The child is marked dead.
      generation - The generation is the process generation that ended.

    • chunkText

      private static String chunkText(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode update)
      The chunkText method reads the text from one session update. A null update returns an empty string. A null content node returns an empty string. Textual content is returned as text. Any other content uses its text field.
      Parameters:
      update - The update is the session update object.
      Returns:
      The return value is the chunk text, or an empty string.

    • text

      private static String text(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode node)
      The text method reads a JSON node as text. A null node or a JSON null returns an empty string.
      Parameters:
      node - The node is the JSON value.
      Returns:
      The return value is the text, or an empty string.

    • authWords

      private static boolean authWords(String message)
      The authWords method reports whether a message looks like an authentication failure. A null message is treated as empty. The check is lowercase. The message matches when it contains login or auth.
      Parameters:
      message - The message is the error text.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when the message contains those words.

    • deathMessage

      private String deathMessage(PoolChatServer.Child child, boolean retried)
      The deathMessage method builds the pool down detail for a dead process. An exit code of zero or more is included. A forwarded turn adds chunk 1. A turn with no forwarded chunk adds chunk 0. A retry adds retry used. The pieces are clipped as place exit.
      Parameters:
      child - The child supplies the exit code, the forwarded flag, and the note counts.
      retried - The flag is true when this death follows a restart.
      Returns:
      The return value is the clipped message.

    • exceptionLine

      private String exceptionLine(PoolChatServer.Child child, Exception ex)
      The exceptionLine method builds a pool payload line from an exception. Only the first line of the exception message is kept. The detail starts with the exception class name. A non-empty message is redacted and appended. A null step uses place stdout.
      Parameters:
      child - The child supplies the step name.
      ex - The exception is the failure.
      Returns:
      The return value is the clipped message.

    • quote

      private static String quote(String raw)
      The quote method redacts a stdout fragment and limits it to 80 characters.
      Parameters:
      raw - The raw text is the fragment.
      Returns:
      The return value is the redacted fragment, cut at 80 characters.

    • clip

      private static String clip(String reason, String place, String detail, PoolChatServer.Child child)
      The clip method builds one sink message and limits it to 240 characters. The reason comes first. A non-empty place and a non-empty detail follow. A note count and a stderr byte count are appended when they are above zero. The text is redacted. Carriage return and line feed become spaces. An empty result becomes the reason. A result that does not start with the reason is prefixed with the reason. Text longer than 240 characters is cut to 240.
      Parameters:
      reason - The reason is the done reason.
      place - The place is the step name.
      detail - The detail is the extra text.
      child - The child supplies note and stderr counts. A null child omits them.
      Returns:
      The return value is the clipped message.

    • redact

      private static String redact(String raw)
      The redact method hides secrets in one string. A null or empty string returns empty. A bearer token becomes redacted. A token that starts with xai- or sk- and has at least eight more token characters becomes redacted. An access_token, api_key, or refresh_token assignment becomes redacted.
      Parameters:
      raw - The raw text may contain a secret.
      Returns:
      The return value is the redacted text.

    • readCapped

      private PoolChatServer.Line readCapped(InputStream in) throws IOException
      The readCapped method reads one stdout line with a 1 MiB cap. Carriage return is skipped. A zero byte marks the line, clears the buffer, and drops the rest of the line. A buffer that reaches 1 MiB marks the line over size, clears the buffer, and drops the rest. End of stream with an empty clean buffer returns an eof line. Any other end returns the bytes read so far.
      Parameters:
      in - The stream is the child stdout.
      Returns:
      The return value is the line record.
      Throws:
      IOException - The method throws this exception when the read fails.
